artifact_observations.reasoning: The paper lacks fine fiber texture and appears overly smooth/plastic-like, with slightly unnatural curling at the edges that suggests minor geometric warping rather than physical paper behavior.

The keys on the far right edge appear to merge slightly into the chassis casing without clear separation gaps, suggesting a minor fusion artifact common in AI generations of complex mechanical assemblies.

The rows of round keys exhibit slight waviness and inconsistent spacing that doesn't perfectly align with the rigid perspective lines of the typewriter body, indicating subtle geometric inconsistency.
